title: 13 Best Origanum Majorana Benefits

It commonly affects individuals with weakened immune systems, including the elderly, children, and those with chronic illnesses. The origanum majorana plant, also known as sweet marjoram, has been found to support immune function by providing essential nutrients and bioactive compounds. Regular consumption of this herb may help enhance the body's natural defenses and reduce the risk of infections.
benefits.constituents: Origanum majorana boosts immune system because it contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and alkaloids. These compounds possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that support immune function. Flavonoids help neutralize free radicals, reducing oxidative stress on immune cells. benefits.study: According to "Frontiers in nutrition", Origanum majorana (specifically its compound procumboside B) was found to boost the immune system by increasing the secretion of nitric oxide, interleukin-6, tumor necrosis factor-alpha, and reactive oxygen species.

It is commonly experienced by individuals with chronic illnesses, smokers, and those exposed to environmental pollutants. The origanum majorana plant, also known as sweet marjoram, has been shown to boost antioxidant levels, helping to combat oxidative stress and support overall cellular health. Its bioactive compounds may enhance the body's defense mechanisms against free radical-induced damage.
